inputs.label: GoldenEye 007 ROM (USA)
inputs.help: Your own GoldenEye 007 (USA / NTSC-U) N64 ROM, about 12 MB.

steps.text: Open GoldenEye VR from Library > Unknown Sources. Press Choose ROM file and pick your ROM in Download. The launcher copies it into place.

notes: The guide also allows pushing straight to Android/data/com.gevr.port/files/data/ge.z64 after one launch; the picker route is used because the launcher handles .v64 and .n64 names. The release also has GoldenEyeVR-*-android.apk (phone), a frame APK, iOS, Linux and Windows builds; the pattern avoids them and the -test pre-releases.
